military_benefit.title: America the Beautiful pass waives seasonal vehicle entrance fee
military_benefit.value: $5 seasonal vehicle entrance fee waived for passholders
military_benefit.eligibility: Current U.S. military members and dependents qualify for the free Military Annual Pass; veterans and Gold Star Family members qualify for the free Military Lifetime Pass.
military_benefit.verification_note: FWS states the $5 vehicle fee is waived for America the Beautiful passholders. NPS lists Military Annual and Military Lifetime passes as free for the stated eligible groups.
